sloka: तेषां तु रुदतां शब्दात् प्रतिश्रुत्को ऽभवद्गिरौ ।भ्रातऽणां सह वैदेह्या: सिंहानामिव नर्दताम् ॥ २.१०२.३३॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ tu rudatāṁ śabdāt pratiśrutko 'bhavadgirau ।bhrāta'ṇāṁ saha vaidehyā: siṁhānāmiva nardatām ॥ 2.102.33॥

translations.english: The mountain echoed with the sound of lamentations of all the brothers along with Sita which resembled the roar of lions.
